split.strategy: Inner GroupKFold by engine_id on M4 training engines; fixed M4 held-out engine split

explanations.method: Tree SHAP, tree_path_dependent, feature values transformed using train-only variance mask
explanations.note: SHAP explains the unclipped raw tree regressor output; displayed RUL predictions are post-processed to [0,125] (or nonnegative for uncapped target). Positive SHAP raises predicted RUL; negative SHAP lowers it. Attributions are associations, not causes. Local file saves the 10 largest contributions per sample; omitted contributions can remain.

limitations: The engine holdout was already viewed during M4; use M5 holdout as a descriptive comparison, not as untouched final test evidence.
The official NASA test set has not been accessed or used for tuning, training, or explanations.
Validation metrics are per row; engine_error_summary provides per-engine diagnostics.
Small 3-fold inner CV over two candidates per model family is illustrative, not an exhaustive hyperparameter search.
Do not load untrusted joblib files; they use Python pickle.
